name: Engineering Physics, B.S.
affiliationText: At least B- in all required math and physics courses (MATH 1910, MATH 1920, MATH 2930, MATH 2940, PHYS 1112/1116, PHYS 1110, PHYS 2213/2217, PHYS 2214/2218, PHYS 2210). Note: PHYS 2210 is only required if taking PHYS 2218. For any course that is repeated, the higher grade will be used.

electiveGroups.name: Liberal Studies
electiveGroups.description: Courses from approved liberal arts and humanities distribution list.
electiveGroups.notes: Any approved liberal studies course outside engineering.

electiveGroups.name: Advisor-Approved Elective
electiveGroups.description: Any course approved by your faculty advisor.

electiveGroups.name: Intro Chemistry Sequence
electiveGroups.notes: Chart shows CHEM 2090 & CHEM 2091 as one first-semester box.

electiveGroups.name: Physics I Choice
electiveGroups.description: PHYS 1112 (Mechanics and Heat) or PHYS 1116 (Mechanics and Special Relativity).

electiveGroups.name: Physics III Choice
electiveGroups.description: PHYS 2214 (Oscillations, Waves, Quantum) or PHYS 2218 & PHYS 2210 (Waves/Thermal + Exploring Experimental Physics).
electiveGroups.notes: Chart box 'PHYS 2214 or PHYS 2218 & PHYS 2210'. PHYS 2210 only required if taking PHYS 2218. All live.

electiveGroups.name: Major-Approved Elective
electiveGroups.description: Five of the six major-approved electives: technical courses at the 3000 level or above.
electiveGroups.notes: Listed: engineering, math, physics, chemistry, astronomy, statistics and biology courses at 3000+ with 3+ credits. Not checked here: 18 credits across the six, at least 9 of them outside AEP; at most three independent study, research or project-team courses, in your last four semesters; letter grade, C- or better. A third course of AEP 3560 / 3620 / 4340 counts here.

electiveGroups.name: Major-Approved Elective (any level)
electiveGroups.description: One major-approved elective at any level: a technical course.
electiveGroups.notes: Listed: engineering, math, physics, chemistry, astronomy, statistics and biology courses numbered 1100+ with 3+ credits (not MATH 1110 or 1900, or CS 1109). It counts toward the major-approved rules: 18 credits in all, 9 outside AEP.

electiveGroups.name: Advanced AEP Course
electiveGroups.description: Two of AEP 3560 (Intermediate Electrodynamics), AEP 3620 (Intermediate Quantum Mechanics) and AEP 4340 (Fluid and Continuum Mechanics).
electiveGroups.notes: If you take all three, the third counts as a major-approved elective. Students planning a physics Ph.D. are advised to take AEP 3560 and 3620.
